name_input: I O L CHEMICALS AND PHARMACEUTICALS LTD
export_evidence: No individual export shipment record (date / destination / HS / B-L number) could be retrieved. importkey.com/countries/india/iol-chemicals-and-pharmaceuticals-ltd resolves to a company page but shows 0 visible shipment rows behind a paywall: "Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world." volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com returned HTTP 403; importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge; seair.co.in exporter page returned 404. Only indirect corroboration found: Screener.in company profile states "It serves the domestic and export market" — a description, not a shipment record. Source counter: 5 trade-data sources attempted, 0 shipment rows actually seen.
domestic_evidence: Screener.in consolidated financials (BSE: 524164 / NSE: IOLCP) show continuous, material domestic-scale turnover: "Mar 2025 ... Sales 2,079" and "Mar 2026 ... Sales 2,319" (Rs crore, consolidated), with quarterly sales of 756 / 795 in Mar-2026 and Jun-2026. Screener profile: "IOL Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd is a leading pharmaceutical (APIs) company and is a significant player in the specialty chemicals space." This confirms real, ongoing commercial supply activity and GST-scale turnover, but the annual report's domestic-vs-export revenue split and any GeM/CPPP tender records were not retrieved in this pass. Source counter: 1 source read (Screener.in), revenue figures seen for FY2015–FY2026 plus 13 quarters.
note: Legal entity exists and is listed (BSE 524164, NSE IOLCP), market cap ~Rs 5,251 Cr — no grounds for rejection. Declared HS 293339 (heterocyclic compounds — pyridine/piperidine derivatives) is consistent with the company's actual product basket (Ibuprofen, Metformin HCl, Clopidogrel, Pantoprazole Sodium, Levetiracetam, Lamotrigine, Losartan Potassium), so no HS correction is indicated on the evidence seen. Revenue: FY2025 Rs 2,079 Cr, FY2026 Rs 2,319 Cr (consolidated, Screener.in); export volume in USD/tonnes: null — not public in the sources read. Export status is 'declared_only' strictly because no dated customs/B-L line was visible: the company is a known global Ibuprofen exporter (~35% world share per Screener), but per Rule 5 a website/profile statement is not a shipment fact. Domestic supply is confirmed by audited-scale turnover, not by tender records. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unavailable during this pass, which limited discovery of additional free shipment views; a re-check against a paid Volza/Eximpedia view or the FY25 annual report's segment note would upgrade export_status to confirmed.
